CHAPTER.CAPTION: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
CHAPTER.VERS: How long will You forget me, O Jehovah? Forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my inner being daily? How long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
Consider and answer me, O Jehovah my God; enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him, and those who oppress me rejoice when I am shaken.
But I have trusted in Your mercy; my heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.
I will sing to Jehovah, because He has dealt bountifully with me.
